subject.title: auth probe: token-type profile not counted as effective for claude-cli provider (TUI stuck on 'auth expired')

question: Should maintainers accept the linked PR's OAuth-first, token/setup-token fallback for gateway model-auth status and land it as the fix for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the false-warning path, but the candidate fix intentionally changes provider auth-status semantics for OAuth-configured token-only setups, so maintainer acceptance should happen in the linked PR before this issue closes.

options.title: Land the linked fallback fix
options.body: Accept token/setup-token as the fallback status source when no effective OAuth profile exists, preserving explicit auth-order behavior and closing this issue after merge.

options.title: Choose a different auth-status policy
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a revised PR if maintainers want runtime or doctor policy to own token-only migrations instead of the gateway status projection.

recommendation.title: Land the linked fallback fix
recommendation.body: Accept token/setup-token as the fallback status source when no effective OAuth profile exists, preserving explicit auth-order behavior and closing this issue after merge.
